messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "increased to 10 mg three times a day based on your response"
set: ["increased to 10 mg three times a day based on your response", "can be increased to 10 mg three times a day if needed", "taken up to three times a day", "increase to 100 mg orally three times a day after 3 days", "immediate-release tablets are taken three times a day", "three times daily", "dose increases should be based on clinical response", "dose determined by doctor based on condition, age, and response to treatment", "doctor will determine right dose based on condition and response to treatment", "doctor will adjust dose based on blood tests and response", "8 mg taken orally 2 times a day", "maintenance dose 10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "initial dose 10 mg orally once a day", "your doctor will determine your dose based on your kidney function", "final dosage is 25 mg four times a day", "reduction depends on therapeutic response"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
